appDescription: An in-car English coach for commuters. It asks short spoken English questions when driving is calm, goes silent when the driver needs to focus, and scores answers inside the car without sending anything to a server.

function.name: START_ENGLISH_SESSION
function.description: Start a hands-free English practice session that adapts to the current driving load.

track.description: Optional learning track for this session.

function.name: REVIEW_NOW
function.description: Review the English expressions that are due now, starting with today's mistakes.

function.name: SAVE_EXPRESSION
function.description: Save the current English expression, or the given text, to the learner's notebook in the car.
